t7_clip_mapping_b2bc_20261030.lane: B2b/c - T7 requirements-table decode + ambiguous-pool fingerprint pass (2026-10-30)
t7_clip_mapping_b2bc_20261030.requirements_decode_verdict: Requirements are a flat (condition u32, param u32) table; a cancel's requirements_idx is the index of a run terminated by condition 881 (list end - verified: every nonzero-idx cancel run in all 8 fighters terminates at 881; idx 0 = no requirements). The v1 graph gap was three stacked causes: (1) input-sequence cancel commands (direction 0x800D+k, plus dash 0x8001/0x8002 and tap 0x8003/0x8004) were dropped as hex strings - decoded here from raw.input_sequences/raw.inputs; (2) unconditional empty-input auto-cancels act as pass-through intermediates in string chains (cap10Eb, Newhakuro, 2RLpunc2, renda2R, FeSt_RPrv, haradadaP, karate01_R_C); (3) unique terminals in throw/pose/bound move classes (damage/startup carried in hit conditions or properties) were excluded by the v1 attack-class filter. Condition 0x81DC (33244) takes a move-id param (previous/related move). Validation: the v2 graph re-derived 479 of the 481 prior mappings to the identical motbin move; the 2 differences were adjudicated by hand and the prior mappings kept (diablo f,F+1+2 - a v2 sequence edge adds a same-tier throw-system competitor, original He_zutuki kept; pantera f,f,n,1+2 Lay Off - a v2 dash edge promotes Kg_BodyAt00 over the original Co_Fcross, flagged in the decode doc, original kept).
t7_clip_mapping_b2bc_20261030.fingerprint_pass: All 91 ambiguous-pool moves scored (damage + startup, the shared fields) against their candidate motbin records; 90 remain after 1 was resolved by the v2 graph (pantera f,f,F+3+4). Scores are recorded per entry in the fingerprint_pass field. NO mapping was promoted on fingerprint evidence alone: calibration on 132 known multi-candidate pools from the 481 showed a unique-exact damage+startup match would have been WRONG on 9 of 26 unique-exact cases (35%; startup-only unique-exact wrong on 9 of 55), because the WH frame-data blocks diverge systematically from T7 motbin values (WH damage >= motbin damage on 115/120 calibrated single moves). Fingerprint evidence was used only as corroboration where the graph already decided (diablo f,F+3 startup 20 == 20; skull d+1+2,3 finisher damage 20 from the WH per-hit damage list).
t7_clip_mapping_b2bc_20261030.held_requirement_pool_diagnoses: Recorded per entry in the b2bc_diagnosis field of the 10 still-unmapped requirement-pool moves (burger Course Achuto + Quick Langouste, demonio Mental Alertness 2, kinpo Basho Oroshi + both 10-hit combos, phantom Thunder Blade + Confusion, skull Flying Knee Kick; plus kinpo ws2-prefixed 10-hit variant counted once per combo).

t7_clip_mapping_v2_other_20261030.method: Each of the 89 'other'-pool entries (v1 reason: 'motbin graph candidate exists but no MVL corroboration and/or non-unique') had its full input sequence walked over the v2 cancel graph: input-sequence/dash/tap/flag command edges + unconditional empty-input pass-through auto-cancels + bound/throw/pose-class terminals; direction-set chords checked as veto-only.
